Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family]]): Players Committee card image first published 20 December 2023<ref name="ht-7388e1a">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual23-Light/large/ahsokafriendofthefamily.gif</code> as published 20 December 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7388e1a0338d8cbd85d7ba6ea318ec0e923f2264/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/ahsokafriendofthefamily.gif holotable commit 7388e1a] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While your [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, Ahsoka ignores its deployment restrictions and, once per turn, may subtract 1 from a non-weapon destiny draw targeting your character's ability or defense value. Characters Ahsoka 'hits' are forfeit = 0. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 2 August 2024: “While your [Skywalker] Epic Event on table, Ahsoka ignores its deployment restrictions and, once per turn, may subtract 1 from a non-weapon destiny draw targeting your character's ability or defense value. Characters Ahsoka 'hits' are forfeit = 0. Immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family]] (published 20 December 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Ahsoka Tano, Friend Of The Family”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The sheet's label reads “•Ahsoka Tano, Friend Of The Family”, not “Ahsoka, Friend Of The Family” as the card's title line prints; recorded as printed. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
